details:
Observed in versions: 
Build 933 to 1007
Description of bug: 
When using the PC version of VRChat that is distributed on the Oculus store, the camera's near clip plane is pretty far away. You don't have to get that close to a wall, mirror, or another person before the near clip plane starts 'slicing' through. In fact, even in desktop mode, you can walk up to any wall and see the near clip plane 'slicing' through it at certain angles.
This issue is not observed on the SteamVR version of VRChat.
This issue is only observed on certain worlds. Many worlds, especially any worlds that have post-processing effects typically have more sensible values for the camera near clip plane.
Another interesting thing to note is that this issue can be 'fixed' by going to any world with a closer near clip plane and then going back to a world where you previously observed a far away near clip plane. Now, the near clip plane on that world will be 'fixed'.
Some examples of worlds showing this issue: 
• VRChat Home
• VRChat Hub
• The Great Pug - West
My hypothesis:
The near clip plane is set too far away on the default Reference Camera of the Oculus store version of VRChat. Worlds that override the Reference Camera on the 'VRC_Scene Descriptor', may use a closer near clip plane. If a world doesn't override the Reference Camera, then VRChat will either use some default value or use the value from the previously-joined world.
My suggested solution is to simply align the value for the default near clip plane on the Oculus store version of VRChat with whatever value is currently in use on the SteamVR version of VRChat.
Steps to reproduce:
1. Launch the Oculus store version of VRChat. 
2. If your Home world is set to a world that doesn't exhibit this issue, then you'll need to change to one of the example worlds I mentioned above and then restart VRChat.
3. Walk up to a wall or mirror and move your head close. You will see that the near clip plane starts 'slicing' through the world remarkably easily.
title: Near clip plane too far away on Oculus version
